title: Home
summary: The one Home in the Platform sidebar context: attention from one server read, the Platform ready checklist for platform admins while it is incomplete, and the products as ST-36 cards with a Cards/Table toggle and facets. The Products page and the summary tiles are gone.
compare: The sidebar is the Platform context: a context header (Platform, 3 products, switcher chevrons), then Home, Members, Connections, Settings, Packages, Status, Activity, and no product sections.

Header: 'Home', then 'Updated 1 min ago', Refresh and New product on one 36px line. No subtitle: the product count is in the sidebar context and beside Products, the attention count beside Needs attention (EXPERIENCE §2: a subtitle only for live state shown nowhere else).

Needs attention lists only broken things (failed resync, missing required secret, expiring store credential): a tone pill with its word, the product's logo and name, one sentence that names the product once, and one action link. The count sits 8px after the title as a filled tone chip; every head count sits beside its title, never at the far right. The sentence wraps in full and is never cut with an ellipsis; the pill, subject and link stay on its first line. Integration progress never appears here.
Attention comes from one server read (GET /manage/api/attention); the old summary tiles (Products, Need attention, Linked to a repository) are gone.

Platform ready shows only to platform admins and only while incomplete. Its head is the title and the '8 of 9 done' meter only: no description and no icon tile, so the title starts at the card edge like Needs attention. Open rows come first with their one action (here only Store accounts: 'Diceroll's Steam uploads need a Steamworks publisher key.', Connect Steam on the right); the 20px mark is centred in the card's 28px media column, so the task title starts on the text column (card-px + 28 + 12). Done steps fold into one 'Show done steps' disclosure at every size (chevron in the media column, 24px hit height, aria-expanded), with no eyebrow and no count, since the meter carries 8; expanded, the eight items wrap from the text column. Team access is done because the platform has 6 members (Members in the Platform sidebar, Tomás Okafor on DJDL); the task only shows while you're the only member.

Product cards keep ST-36's shape: logo, name as the one link, slug in mono, an attention pill at the right edge only when something needs attention, and one row of glyphs, one per feature in canonical order (not one per service), each with a tooltip and an accessible name; the issue dot sits on the feature with the problem. The pill names a single issue, as the built ProductCard does ('Missing secret' on DJDL) and counts several ('2 need attention' on Diceroll). No facts, no footer, no healthy pill. This amends ST-44's acceptance wording 'service icons' to feature icons: Ship builds is one package glyph, never release, distribution and update.

DJDL shows five glyphs (Licensing, Managed config with a warning dot, Ship builds, Sign-in, Cloud Sync); Diceroll four (Licensing, Managed config, Ship builds with a danger dot for the failed resync and the Google Play key, Commerce: its own store glyph in the distribution green, last); Polaris Key two (Ship builds, Sign-in). Diceroll has no Sign-in, so no Cloud Sync, matching products.features.

Products: the title at the block step (18/24, the same as Needs attention and Platform ready) with its count; the Cards/Table segmented control on the heading line, right-aligned; the toolbar is one 32px height (Filter products, the 'Integration verified' facet, which is ST-44's Setup complete facet renamed, and the Needs attention facet) on one centre line. 'Setup complete' appears nowhere.

Wide (1600 and up): the page head spans the page; the main column holds Needs attention, then Products as three 384px cards (at 1920); Platform ready is the 400px aside beside them, with Connect Steam under the task's text. Source order stays Needs attention, Platform ready, Products, so desktop, tablet and phone keep that order.

Tablet (1024–1279): the sidebar is the console's 56px icon rail (each item 40×40 with its tooltip), so content is 920px at 1024. Every attention sentence shows in full: the resync row wraps to two lines (12px above and below) with the pill, subject and link on its first line; nothing is cut with an ellipsis. Product cards go two plus one.

Phone: the sidebar folds into the menu button. The title row ends in Refresh (icon, aria-label 'Refresh, updated 1 min ago'), 'Updated 1 min ago' is the 12/16 meta line under the h1, and New product takes the full-width action row alone. The top-bar search becomes an icon but Filter products stays a full-width field. Attention rows stack (pill and subject as one group, 8px apart, then the sentence, then the action link with a 24px hit height). Each card shows one pip per feature beside the name; the pip row's accessible name includes the issue ('Licensing, Managed config: 1 needs attention, …').

Copy: 'Resync failed: .pkey/release line 14 names “switch”, a platform this product doesn't ship.', 'Required secret identity.acoustidKey has no value in the Default profile.', 'Google Play key expires Oct 16; uploads to Play stop then.' The done item is 'Platform packages' (glossary: Packages, not package feeds); the Store connections row names only the problem.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.
From 1280px Needs attention takes two thirds and Platform ready the third beside it, top-aligned; below 1280 they stack, attention first; no column under 280px (admin-1-13, overview-13).

Product cards carry a 72px cover banner in the Cards view only: the product's hosted art, else its stored flat tint (Polaris Key here), never a gradient; each feature glyph is a 32px bordered tile (a link); a phone keeps the one-line card with pips.
Platform ready's open task is 'Store accounts' (the retired 'Store connections' page name is gone).
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): The Platform and Product sidebar contexts are unchanged
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): The feature model (one glyph per feature, one Ship builds) is unchanged
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): Home shows attention-only data: no stat tile repeats the attention list

designReview.reviewer: Lead product designer, deciding on five UX reviews (UX1 spacing, UX2 content, UX3 flow, UX4 accessibility and responsive, UX5 first-time operator)
designReview.verdict: Applied: four sizes (56px rail at tablet, main + aside at wide), attention sentences wrap in full, one 28px media column, one 18/24 block step, counts beside titles, no subtitle, Platform ready without narration and with a 'Show done steps' disclosure. Declined items keep content and states for a later states pass or follow ST-36/ST-44/ST-45.

findings.issue: Header subtitle '3 products · 3 things need attention' repeated the sidebar context, the Products count, the Needs attention count and the card pills within 60px.
findings.resolution: Deleted the .page-sub. Desktop and tablet: one 36px line, 'Home', then 'Updated 1 min ago', Refresh and New product.

findings.issue: Phone showed Refresh with no freshness, and the icon action sat before the primary.
findings.resolution: Kit phone header: Refresh (icon) ends the title row, 'Updated 1 min ago' is the 12/16 meta line under the h1, New product takes the full-width row alone. Refresh's aria-label is 'Refresh, updated 1 min ago'.

findings.issue: The attention count sat about 1,000px from its title while the Products count sat 8px after its own; row 1 named Diceroll twice, row 3 was two sentences with the page's only year, row 2 opened with a filler 'The'.
findings.resolution: The count sits 8px after the title in the title cluster as a filled tone chip (kit). Rows: 'Resync failed: .pkey/release line 14 names “switch”, a platform this product doesn't ship.', 'Required secret identity.acoustidKey has no value in the Default profile.', 'Google Play key expires Oct 16; uploads to Play stop then.' Pills keep 'Error' and 'Warning'.

findings.issue: At 1024 every attention sentence was cut with an ellipsis (53–71% visible), so the card lost the fact it exists to state.
findings.resolution: Tablet uses the 56px icon rail (kit), so content is 920px. .attn-text wraps in full at every size; the pill, subject and link stay on the first line. At 1024 the resync row wraps to two lines (64px, 12 above and below) with nothing cut; the other two rows are one line at 56px. Product cards go 2 + 1.

findings.issue: Platform ready narrated its mechanism ('leaves Home when all nine are done'), had four left edges, a done list of two or three lines, and a 20px '8 steps · Show' target on phone.
findings.resolution: Head is 'Platform ready' and the '8 of 9 done' meter only (description and rocket tile deleted; the title starts at the card edge). The task mark is centred in the 28px media column, so 'Store connections' starts at card-px + 28 + 12; copy 'Diceroll's Steam uploads need a Steamworks publisher key.'; Connect Steam on the right. Done is one 'Show done steps' disclosure row at every size (chevron in the media column, 24px hit height, aria-expanded, no eyebrow, no count); expanded items wrap from the text column.

findings.issue: At 1920 the page only stretched: action links 600–774px from their sentences, the meter 1,278px from its title, cards shrunk to 310px with two empty tracks.
findings.resolution: The page is .page.columns (kit). At 1600 and up the head spans both columns; the main column (1184px at 1920) holds Needs attention, then Products as three 384px cards; Platform ready is the 400px aside (.aside.span-2), its task putting Connect Steam under the text. Source order is unchanged, so narrower sizes keep today's order.

findings.issue: Products' 36px field sat 2px off the 32px chips' centre line; cards used the legacy .row.gap-1; '1 needs attention' differed from the built card; the phone pips dropped the issue from their name.
findings.resolution: Products title at the block step with its count; the toolbar field is 32px in a toolbar (kit), one centre line with the facets and Cards/Table. Cards use .mk-cluster-1. DJDL's pill reads 'Missing secret'; Diceroll keeps '2 need attention'. Pip rows name the issue ('…, Managed config: 1 needs attention, …'; '…, Ship builds: 2 need attention, …').

findings.issue: Compare item 4 ('folded into one line') was already false at 1440 and 1024, and nothing described the phone header or the wide layout.
findings.resolution: Compare rewritten: Platform ready (no description, 'Show done steps' at every size, task title on the text column), the phone header, a wide-layout item, a tablet item, the DJDL pill wording and head counts beside their titles.

findings.issue: States boards (first run with 0 products, attention read failed, all clear, loading, editor without Platform ready, Table view, no filter match).
findings.resolution: Declined: New content and states; this pass fixes spacing, alignment and hierarchy only. Queued for a states pass, drawn on the new system.

findings.issue: Replace the 'Error'/'Warning' pills with a 16px glyph plus sr-only text, or icon-only pills below 1100px.
findings.resolution: Declined: Owner rule: issues are pills. With .attn-text wrapping nothing is truncated; subgrid aligns subjects on desktop and the phone 8px gap fixes the jitter.

findings.issue: Drop the product card's attention pill, or shrink it to an icon and a number.
findings.resolution: Declined: ST-36's card (ADMIN.md §6.1, the built ProductCard) ends its header with one pill that names or counts. Fixed instead with the built wording.

findings.issue: Replace the phone pips with 16px glyphs or a '5 features' line, or drop pips and slug.
findings.resolution: Declined: Plan §2.1 keeps pips on phones (ST-36, kept by ST-44). Only the accessible name was fixed.

findings.issue: Draw each feature on the card as a .chip.sm with its name.
findings.resolution: Declined: Contradicts ST-36's card shape: one row of feature glyphs with tooltips and names, no facts.

findings.issue: Move page-level titles out of the cards, or set them to 20/28.
findings.resolution: Declined: One 18/24 block step inside the existing card heads (EXPERIENCE §3: panel headers 16–18). Moving titles out would restructure every screen and separate heads from their actions.

findings.issue: Show a head count only when the list is cut short ('3 of 12').
findings.resolution: Declined: With the subtitle gone the head count is the list's only number; sometimes-counts would make identical heads differ.

findings.issue: At wide: cap .page at 1440, put Needs attention and Platform ready side by side above full-width Products, or move Needs attention into a rail.
findings.resolution: Declined: A 1440 cap plus a rail gives a 944px main column, narrower than desktop. Side by side keeps the empty card tracks. Needs attention is the most urgent block and stays first in the main column. A 1760px page max stops 2560 screens stretching.

findings.issue: Cap the attention sentence at 72–80ch, or move the action under the sentence below 800–1200px.
findings.resolution: Declined: Action links stay in one right-hand column; wrapping fixes tablet and the aside fixes wide.

findings.issue: Clamp attention text to two lines with an ellipsis.
findings.resolution: Declined: A clamp still cuts the problem statement; it wraps in full.

findings.issue: A 64px rail, a rail from 640 or 768px, or folding the sidebar up to 1199px.
findings.resolution: Declined: The built console (AppShell defaultRail) starts a 56px rail at 1024–1279 and folds to the drawer below 1024; the mockup matches what ships.

findings.issue: Make the task and done columns 36px so titles line up with a 36px head icon.
findings.resolution: Declined: One 28px media column lines up every card; page-level heads lose their decorative tiles.

findings.issue: Remove the slug from the sidebar context or the cards.
findings.resolution: Declined: ST-45's context header and ST-36's card specify the slug; sidebar chrome isn't page content.

findings.issue: Renames: 'Platform setup', 'Platform packages set up', 'Team invited (6 members)', facet 'Fully verified', a System pill tooltip.
findings.resolution: Declined: UX-67 and ST-44 names, glossary-checked in round 1; done items are folded by default. Not spacing or duplication.

findings.issue: Add Diceroll's missing Steam key as a Needs attention row.
findings.resolution: Declined: Plan §1: a store channel without credentials shows human steps; nothing has broken, so it is setup. The setup wording was taken instead.

findings.issue: Show the toolbar and Cards/Table only above 6 products.
findings.resolution: Declined: ST-44 acceptance items; the reference screen shows them. A threshold belongs to the built screen's states.

findings.issue: Pin Settings in the Platform sidebar foot.
findings.resolution: Declined: ST-45 fixes the Platform order: Home, Members, Connections, Settings, Packages, Status, Activity.

findings.issue: Roving tabindex for card glyphs; tooltips on focus-visible.
findings.resolution: Declined: Keyboard behaviour of the built card; passed to ST-44's built review.

findings.issue: A six-column :has() rule for five tiles; product cards at minmax(320px, 1fr).
findings.resolution: Declined: Superseded: generic tiles fill a short last row, and at wide the main column gives three 384px cards.

findings.issue: 'Updated 1 min ago' in the subtitle slot at every size.
findings.resolution: Declined: On desktop freshness stays beside Refresh on the title line (EXPERIENCE §4); it moves under the h1 only on phone.

findings.issue: Label the done disclosure 'Show 8 done' or '8 done · Show'.
findings.resolution: Declined: The meter already carries 8. The label is 'Show done steps'.

findings.issue: The h1 sat at four different y positions across home, integration, features and new-product.
findings.resolution: Home opts into .kit-prod: a 24px top pad and a reserved 20px breadcrumb row, so the h1 sits at y=137 on all four pages.

previousRounds.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
previousRounds.verdict: Fixed: Platform ready now agrees with the 6 members shown elsewhere (8 of 9), and cards, pips and the switcher speak in features, one glyph each.

findings.issue: Platform ready's open task Team access said 'You're the only member', contradicting Members 6 in the Platform sidebar, Diceroll's 4 members and Tomás Okafor joining DJDL.
findings.resolution: Team access folded into the Done line as 'Team access: 6 members'; the meter reads 8 of 9 and Store connections is the one open task.

findings.issue: Cards showed one icon per service (7 for DJDL's 5 features, 6 for Diceroll's 4) while every other screen speaks in the six features; the three Ship builds icons mapped to nothing a person sees.
findings.resolution: One glyph per feature in canonical order on the cards and the phone pips (and the same in the wizard preview and the switcher): DJDL 5, Diceroll 4, Polaris Key 2. Ship builds is one package glyph carrying the danger dot for the failed resync and the Google Play key. Each glyph has a tooltip and an aria-label with the feature name; each pip row has role=img and a label listing the features. Lead: record this as an amendment to ST-44's acceptance line ('service icons' becomes feature icons).

findings.issue: Phone: attention action links were 20 px tall and card name links 18 px; Cards/Table took a row of its own; the Filter products field disappeared on phone.
findings.resolution: Attention action links get a 24 px minimum hit height and sit at their own width on phone. Cards/Table moved onto the Products heading line, right-aligned. Filter products stays on phone as a full-width field. The card name link needs no change: its ::after stretches over the whole card, so its hit area is the card.

findings.issue: Copy: '+ Integration' didn't say what it filters; the Store connections task listed only Google Play and Steam; 'Platform package feeds' used the old word.
findings.resolution: Facet renamed 'Integration verified' (ST-44 turns the Setup complete facet into Verified). Store connections now reads 'Steam has no Steamworks publisher key yet, so Diceroll's Steam channel can't upload builds.' Done item renamed 'Platform packages'.
